o_proj_std_observation.critical_finding: shim v4 fresh-init ALSO produces o_proj_std~0.02 (NOT 0.001 as spec hypothesised). Root cause: ConsciousDecoderV3.__init__ calls self.apply(self._init_weights) AFTER ConsciousCrossAttention.__init__'s local nn.init.normal_(self.o_proj.weight, std=0.001) at conscious_decoder.py:420. Therefore the 0.001 init at line 420 is OVERWRITTEN by _init_weights to 0.02 in fresh init, making shim v4 and shim v5 IDENTICAL on fresh init. This invalidates the F-SHIM-V4-4 verdict's diagnosis that 'std=0.001 makes residual ~zero'. The actual shim v4 init scale is 0.02, same as shim v5.
o_proj_std_observation.implication_for_phase3: F-SHIM-V5-4 (decisive H100 lift_pp >= +5pp) is now ARCHITECTURALLY UNCHANGED vs F-SHIM-V4-4. Re-running F-SHIM-V4-4 on shim v5 cannot produce lift different from shim v4 because the underlying weights are identical (post _init_weights overwrite). RECOMMENDATION: either (a) modify the shim v5 patch P3 to apply std=0.02 AFTER self.apply(self._init_weights) so it actually sticks, OR (b) increase std beyond 0.02 (e.g., 0.05/0.1) so it differs from the apply()-default, OR (c) abandon the init-only approach and queue an SFT cycle with cross-attn participating in the loss (path B per spec §1).
